I grow maize on this small plot because my family needs the food. If I can get the FISP coupon this year, I will use a little fertilizer and some hybrid seed — the coupon makes it affordable, otherwise I cannot buy at market prices. I will put kraal manure from my goats around the planting stations to stretch the fertilizer, and I will weed and ridge by hand with my own labor. I will not spray chemicals or irrigate — the rains must do their work.
